searchText: Hello <@453386940490711054> ! So I tested the submission to my Nimbus node. Without much surprise, it wasn't accepted: `Error: failed to process: failed to submit BLS to execution change: POST failed with status 400: {"code":400,"message":"Unable to decode BLS to execution change object(s)","stacktraces":["Attempt to add to BLS to execution change pool pre-Capella"]}` Do you think there is a strong need of volunteers and I should temporarily switch to another client, or it's fine if I run it again manually after the fork? I can write a script once we know the capella fork block Prysm, lighthouse and lodestar will accept local submissions in cache prior to Capella, and broadcast at Capella. If you want, we do have a “rescuer” bot to help volunteer on other clients such as Teku and nimbus, but as our code is unaudited we don’t recommend it to non-developers: https://github.com/benjaminchodroff/ConsensusLayerWithdrawalProtection/tree/main/rescuer
